features.name: Kotlin PostgreSQL sync service
features.description: Provide a secure Kotlin HTTP API and PostgreSQL persistence for optional anonymous synchronization.
acceptanceCriteria: A separate :server Kotlin module exposes health, installation registration, session upsert, and paged session download endpoints
Android never connects directly to PostgreSQL and no database credential is present in the APK or source tree
PostgreSQL schema is created through checked-in versioned Flyway migrations
Anonymous installation bearer tokens are stored hashed and can be revoked
Session upserts are idempotent on installation ID and client session ID
Only finalized completed or abandoned sessions are accepted and completion rewards cannot be duplicated
Server logs exclude intention text, bearer tokens, and database credentials
Unit and PostgreSQL integration tests cover authentication, migration, upsert, paging, invalid input, and duplicate delivery
verification: :server:postgresIntegrationTest passes against an ephemeral PostgreSQL database

implementation: Added a separate Kotlin/JVM :server module using Ktor, PostgreSQL JDBC/Hikari, and Flyway migrations; database connection settings come only from DATABASE_URL, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, and PORT environment variables.

Added health, anonymous installation registration/revocation, finalized session upload, and stable cursor paging endpoints. Bearer tokens are generated from 256 bits of SecureRandom entropy and only SHA-256 hashes are stored.

Added idempotent session inserts keyed by installation/session UUID; exact duplicate payloads are accepted without creating a second row and conflicting payloads receive HTTP 409. Server has no reward ledger or reward issuance.
Added input validation, generic non-sensitive error responses, and no request-body/call logging. Added versioned Flyway schema constraints and README API/deployment notes.

Added service/route tests and Testcontainers PostgreSQL integration coverage for Flyway migrations, authentication/revocation, validation, idempotency/conflict, and paging. Extended full verification to run both server suites.
